baseline_environment.protocol: Each case gets separate cold and warm workers. Cold wall includes process startup, imports, validation, first engine/render, and report I/O; OS filesystem caches are not cleared. Warm has one untimed warmup then measured repeats. RSS is whole-worker peak before profiling; not engine-only allocation. No container/network-isolation claim.
